Update3 April 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch Notes - Apr 3, 2026
Spring egg hunt: capital baskets and Delicate Gloves for Magical Rabbit Eggs, daily glove drops from Divine Clock, and bonus eggs from long lists of faction rifts/boss quests and dungeon bounties—plus miscellaneous fixes.

Patch Notes - Apr 3, 2026

Easter Eggs

Egg Baskets have appeared in capitals! Delicate Gloves can be used to pickup Magical Rabbit Eggs! The Divine Clock will grant 3x5 gloves every day! On top of this, the following quests will be rewarding Magical Rabbit Eggs:

  • Faction Events
    • The Cursed Towers
    • The Battle of Mistmerrow Basin
    • A Harsh Lesson
    • Lusca Awakening
    • An Eye for an Eye, a Pack for a Pack
    • Harvest Festival Warriors
    • Causing Mayhem in Veroe
  • Rifts/Bosses
    • Crimson Omens 1
    • Crimson Omens 2
    • Crimson Omens 3
    • Defeat the Hound of Kyrios!

    • Halting the Crimson Tide 1

    • Aegis Island Guardian
    • Anthalon's Elite
    • Bounty: Halnaak
    • Bounty: Recordkeeper Wynn

  • Dungeons
    • Greater Bounty: Ancient Titan Musperosa
    • Greater Bounty: Arkanis the Destroyer

  • Minor bugfixes

== Patch Notes - Apr 3, 2026 ==

== Easter Eggs ==

Egg Baskets have appeared in capitals! Delicate Gloves can be used to pickup Magical Rabbit Eggs!
The Divine Clock will grant 3x5 gloves every day!
On top of this, the following quests will be rewarding Magical Rabbit Eggs:

* '''Faction Events'''
** The Cursed Towers
** The Battle of Mistmerrow Basin
** A Harsh Lesson
** Lusca Awakening
** An Eye for an Eye, a Pack for a Pack
** Harvest Festival Warriors
** Causing Mayhem in Veroe
* '''Rifts/Bosses'''
** Crimson Omens 1
** Crimson Omens 2
** Crimson Omens 3
** Defeat the Hound of Kyrios!
** Helping the War Effort
** Halting the Crimson Tide 1
** Halting the Crimson Tide 2
** Aegis Island Guardian
** Anthalon's Elite
** Bounty: Halnaak
** Bounty: Recordkeeper Wynn
** Bounty: Rowan Alexander
** Bounty: Captain Jergant
* '''Dungeons'''
** Greater Bounty: Ancient Titan Musperosa
** Greater Bounty: Arkanis the Destroyer
** Bounty: Sirothe the Infernal
** Bounty: Dahuta## Other
* Minor bugfixes
